name: Generate Analytics Report
description: Create and export a custom analytics report

steps.title: Access Reports Section
steps.description: Navigate to the 'Reports' or 'Analytics' section from the main menu.

steps.title: Select Report Type
steps.description: Choose the type of report you want to generate (e.g., User Activity, Performance Metrics, Usage Statistics).

steps.title: Set Date Range
steps.description: Select the start and end dates for the report data. You can use preset ranges like 'Last 7 days' or 'Last month'.

steps.title: Configure Filters
steps.description: Apply any additional filters such as user groups, departments, or specific metrics you want to include.

steps.title: Preview Report
steps.description: Click 'Preview' to see a sample of the report data before generating the full report.

steps.title: Generate and Export
steps.description: Click 'Generate Report' and choose your preferred export format (PDF, Excel, CSV). The report will be downloaded to your device.
